responsibility: This header declares the scanner’s directory-list structure and the global include-path lists used for ordinary includes and intrinsic modules. It provides the shared path metadata needed by option handling, preprocessing, module loading, and source scanning code.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the shared include/module search-path data structure and extern declarations for those path lists. Unlike gcc/fortran/scanner.cc, it does not implement source-file loading, character normalization, preprocessing interaction, or line/locus scanning logic.
